config.theme: Emblem lock-up: the five-figures-with-flag silhouette in the center, "THE LEAGUE" arced above, "AMAZING PROGRAMMERS" arced below in curved text.

iterations.label: v1 — figures center, THE LEAGUE arced above, AMAZING PROGRAMMERS arced below
iterations.prompt:
A clean single-color emblem logo on a plain pure-white background. One flat solid ORANGE color only (matching the reference silhouette's orange) — no other colors, no gray, no gradients, no shadows, no texture.

CENTER: the group of five stylized figures standing together, one of them raising a flag that carries a lightning bolt — reproduced faithfully from the reference image as a flat orange silhouette. This artwork is the centerpiece and fills the middle of the emblem.

ABOVE the figures: the words "THE LEAGUE" set in bold condensed caps on a gentle UPWARD arc (curving like the top of a circle), centered over the figures, following the crown of the emblem.

BELOW the figures: the words "AMAZING PROGRAMMERS" set in bold condensed caps on a gentle DOWNWARD arc (curving like the bottom of a circle, smile-shaped), centered under the figures, mirroring the top text.

The two curved text lines and the central figures together compose a balanced circular badge / emblem lock-up — text hugging the top and bottom, figures in the middle. All type is the same flat orange as the figures. Bold, condensed, heavy letterforms, evenly spaced along each arc. Generous white margins around the whole emblem. Crisp vector edges.
iterations.negative_prompt: multiple colors, gray tones, shading, gradient, drop shadow, glow, texture, grain, halftone, dark background, photo background, outer ring outline or circle border (unless implied only by the text), straight horizontal text, extra words, misspellings, lightning bolts outside the flag, decorative marks, photorealism, 3D
iterations.notes: First pass: orange five-figures-with-flag silhouette (from source) centered, curved text above and below forming a round emblem lockup.
